title: Update center
description: Check, prepare, and follow a Bubllio upgrade without leaving the CRM.
notConfiguredHelp: Connect the Bubllio update runner on this server before updates can be started here.
disconnectedHelp: The CRM cannot reach the update runner. Check the runner service and connection settings, then try again.
reconnecting: The CRM is restarting or temporarily unavailable. Progress is preserved by the update runner; reconnecting automatically…
upToDate: This installation is up to date.
preflightHelp: Bubllio verifies the release, update runner, database protection, and migration policy before enabling the update.
preflightReady: All required checks passed. This release is ready to start.
preflightBlocked: The update is blocked until the failed checks below are resolved.
preflightEmpty: Run the safety checks to see blockers and backup or restore readiness.
policy_online_safe_help: Designed to run while the installation remains available.
policy_maintenance_help: Plan downtime and confirm recovery evidence before starting.
policy_irreversible_help: This release cannot be rolled back automatically. Review the release guide first.
confirmSafe: The update runner will back up, deploy, and verify this exact release. Keep this page open to follow progress.
confirmRisky: This release needs a maintenance window. Confirm that users have been notified and recovery evidence is current.
confirmIrreversible: This release contains irreversible database changes. Automatic rollback may not be possible.
confirmationMismatch: Enter the exact target version shown above.
stepUpHelp: Confirm your identity immediately before this privileged action. Your password is not stored.
manualOnly: One-click updating is disabled for this release. Use the release guide to schedule and supervise the maintenance operation.
historyEmpty: The runner has not reported any steps yet.
runningVersion: You are running {{version}}. Review readiness and start the upgrade from the Update Center.
loadError: We could not load update information. No update was started.
preflightError: The safety checks could not be completed. Try again after checking the update runner.
startError: The update did not start. Your current installation was not changed.
